This article is a stub. General Aquatics was a California pool equipment company that bought
[Paragon Aquatics](paragon-aquatics.md) in 1995 and was itself acquired by [Essef](essef.md) in
May 1997.

See the [vendors](index.md) register for the companies this wiki covers.
